title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World launches Dec 3 on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, Switch and PC, demo available now
game: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World

sources.note: Steam store API (cc=ae): release 3 Dec 2026, developers Square Enix and TOSE, publisher Square Enix, price 200.00 AED (UAE store, pre-purchase); 'you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle'; 'Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera'; Steam post 10 Sep 'DEMO available now!' (free demo, demo progress and up to 8 monsters transfer to the full game on the same platform); Steam languages list has no Arabic
PlayStation Store page: PS5, 12/3/2026, publisher Square Enix, $59.99 pre-order
Gematsu 12 Nov: 3 Dec worldwide on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, Switch and PC; Bianca (from Dragon Quest V); synthesis needs both monsters at level 10 or higher; early adventure details

first_report: Release date and pre-purchase: Steam post 9 Jun 2026; demo 10 Sep 2026; Gematsu early-adventure details 12 Nov 2026 (2 days old). Not older than 24 h at a new fact: Steam UAE price in dirhams read 14 Nov and not carried by the Arabic press as far as the search showed (not searched in depth)
